title: Detail page: controller/co-op/Workshop capability chips (from data Steam already gives us)
description: Steam's store categories were being downloaded and then mostly ignored. The detail page now renders the decision-relevant ones as chips - Full Controller Support first, then co-op/multiplayer/Cloud/Workshop/Achievements/Leaderboards/Remote Play/HDR/Family Sharing - in a fixed order so they scan identically game-to-game. Unrecognized categories stay hidden (no cryptic raw strings).
commit_message: Detail page: capability chips from Steam categories
author: prepare-chain:claude
